args.title: Add TSV export option alongside CSV and XLSX
args.body:
File: src/export/csv.ts

The current export function writeCsv only supports CSV output with comma delimiters and UTF-8 BOM. To support the request for tab-delimited exports (TSV), add support for producing TSV files as an option alongside CSV and XLSX. This would avoid manual and error-prone conversions outside the system when transaction descriptions contain commas. The change involves extending or modifying the export functions to handle tab delimiters and adjust content type correspondingly.
